headline: One keeps the room half-drawn.
body: The hour after noon does not announce itself; it only lets the window go a shade paler and leaves the clock to its small, unhurried click. A cup cools where it was set and no one moves it. Outside, a bus doors open on an empty stop and close again, as if the street had merely checked its pockets.

pulses.label: Mood
pulses.value: the desk still warm from noon
